purpose: Test whether the fast captured-action implementation omits outcome-changing bfloat16 rounding from explicitly materialized rank-one matrices.
fidelity_requirements: materialize W_gate + delta_W_gate at every layer
materialize W_up + delta_W_up at every layer
materialize W_down + delta_W_down for the stable method at every layer
use the actual reduced-context attention computation
compare explicit logits to the captured-action and contextual logits
retain an unpatched reduced-context negative control

interpretation.concordant: All explicit and action tokens agree and maximum action-versus-explicit logit L-infinity error is at most 1.0.
interpretation.divergent: The explicit route changes a token or exceeds the concordance bound; the 100-token action result cannot alone settle the paper percentages.

verdict_scope: This is a fidelity audit of the 100-token route, not an independent estimate of a 100-token agreement percentage.
